title: Parasite
overview: A family folds pizza boxes, then folds themselves into a rich house. Stairs, smell, and a plan that does not survive the rain.
tagline: Act Like You Own The Place

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
overview: A laundromat, a IRS meeting, and every life you did not live crashing the party. Googly eyes as cosmology.
tagline: The Multiverse Is A Tax Audit

title: Oppenheimer
overview: A man builds a sun in the desert and then has to live with the light. IMAX faces, chain-smoking, and a hearing that is also a trial.

title: Moonlight
overview: Three acts, one boy, Miami light that looks like memory. Little, Chiron, Black — the names keep changing. The person does not.

title: 12 Years a Slave
overview: A free man stolen south. Solomon Northup's years rendered without the mercy of montage.

title: The Godfather Part II
overview: Michael in Tahoe, Vito in Sicily, and a sequel that is also an origin. The chairs get colder.
tagline: I Know It Was You, Fredo

title: The Departed
overview: A cop in the mob, a mobster in the cops, and Boston as a rat maze. Cell phones, rooftops, and envelopes of cash.
tagline: Cops Or Criminals. When You're Facing A Loaded Gun, What's The Difference?

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
overview: The mountain, the king, the hobbits who walked there. Endings stacked like extra endings, and they all earn the tears.

title: Get Out
overview: Meet the parents. The sunken place is waiting in the backyard. A horror comedy that is neither a joke nor just a scare.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
overview: A chase that is also a rescue that is also a return. Chrome, chrome, chrome, and Charlize Theron with a missing arm and a war rig.
tagline: Witless, Gulping, Bastard. Oh, What A Day.

title: Dune
overview: A boy, a desert, a spice that is also a future. The bagpipes hit and the worms come. Part one of a prophecy.
tagline: Dreams Are Messages From The Deep

title: Dune: Part Two
overview: Paul walks into the fundamentalism he was trying to dodge. Sand, prophecy, and a holy war he can already see.
tagline: You Will Never Lose Me, As Long As You Stay Who You Are

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
overview: Miles Morales glitches into every other Spider-Man. The dots are the point. So is the leap.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
director: Joaquim Dos Santos, Kemp Powers, Justin K. Thompson
overview: Miles vs. the society of every canon. Gwen in watercolor, spots in ink, and a sequel that refuses to sit still.
tagline: Nah. I'm Gonna Do My Own Thing

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
overview: A concierge, a lobby boy, a stolen painting, and a Europe that is already disappearing. Mendl's boxes and a prison break in pastel.
tagline: There Are Still Faint Glimmers Of Civilization

title: The Social Network
overview: A dorm room, a deposition, and a friendship that becomes a company that becomes a lawsuit. The score never blinks.
tagline: You Don't Get To 500 Million Friends Without Making A Few Enemies

title: Inglourious Basterds
overview: A dairy farm, a basement tavern, a cinema packed with Nazis, and a Jewish woman who owns the projector. Opening night is the war.
tagline: I Think This Just Might Be My Masterpiece

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
overview: A bride wakes up. The list is five names. Tokyo blood in anime and steel. House of Blue Leaves does not stay blue.
tagline: Revenge Is A Dish Best Served Cold

title: Django Unchained
overview: A bounty hunter and a freed man ride south in winter. Candyland is not a board game. The dentist wagon has a surprise.

title: Lady Bird
overview: Sacramento, a mother, a daughter, and a name she gave herself. The last drive around town is the whole movie.
tagline: I Want To Live Through Something

title: La La Land
overview: A pianist and an actress in a Los Angeles that still believes in the number. The epilogue is the one that hurts.
tagline: Here's To The Fools Who Dream

title: Hereditary
overview: A miniature house, a family that cannot stop repeating, and a party in the attic you should not attend. The cluck is the jump.

title: Midsommar
overview: A breakup, a trip to Sweden, and daylight that never lets you hide. The maypole is not a dance. It is a sentence.

title: The Lighthouse
overview: Two wickies, one lamp, too much drink, a mermaid, and a gull you should not have harmed. Square frames and sea salt in the teeth.

title: Uncut Gems
overview: Howard can't stop betting. The opal is in the building. The Knicks are on. Manhattan as a panic attack with jewelry.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
overview: A painter, a subject who is not supposed to look back, an island, and a fire that is also a look across an opera house.
tagline: Do All Lovers Feel They Are Inventing Something?

title: In the Mood for Love
overview: Two neighbors, two missing spouses, a hallway, a noodle stall, and a secret whispered into a hole in Angkor Wat.

title: Mulholland Drive
overview: A blonde, a brunette, a blue box, a Club Silencio, and a Hollywood that eats its own. The audition is the tell.

title: Shaun of the Dead
overview: A dump, a pub, a cricket bat, and the end of the world on a bank holiday. The records you throw are the ones you never liked.

title: Hot Fuzz
overview: A London super-cop reassigned to a village where the lawns are too perfect and the accidents are not. Cornetto trilogy, second scoop.
tagline: Everyone And Their Mums Is Packing Round Here

title: Paddington 2
overview: A bear, a pop-up book, a stolen gift, and Hugh Grant having the time of his life as a washed-up actor. Kindness as a heist movie.
tagline: If We're Kind And Polite, The World Will Be Right

title: Coco
overview: A boy in the land of the dead looking for a musician who may not be the hero of the family story. Remember me, then remember who.

title: WALL-E
overview: A trash-compacting robot finds a plant and a directive. Forty minutes of almost no dialogue, then the stars.

title: The Handmaiden
overview: A pickpocket hired as a maid, a lady in a Japanese mansion, and a con that keeps flipping the table. Gloves come off twice.
tagline: Count Your Books. Count Your Women.

title: Memories of Murder
overview: Rural cops vs. a killer they cannot catch, and a rain that keeps the evidence. The last look into the camera still stings.

title: Drive
overview: A stuntman who moonlights as a getaway. A scorpion jacket, a moment of kindness, and an elevator that does not forgive.
tagline: I Don't Carry A Gun. I Drive.

title: John Wick
overview: A car, a dog, a pencil, a Continental. The retired hitman is not retired. Neon rain and gun-fu as grief.
tagline: People Keep Asking If I'm Back

title: Knives Out
overview: A famous novelist, a family of vultures, a nurse who cannot lie, and a detective with a southern drawl and a donut hole.
tagline: The Butler Did It? Wait. No.

title: Barbie
overview: Stereotypical Barbie leaves Barbieland and finds the real world has thoughts. Pink, patriarchy, and a monologue on being a person.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
overview: The kid is now the teacher. The plane is analog on purpose. A sequel that actually understands why people went in the first place.

title: A Quiet Place
overview: A family that cannot make a sound, because the thing in the woods hunts noise. Monopoly, a nail, a silo, a baby.
tagline: If They Hear You, They Hunt You

title: Arrival
overview: Twelve ships, a linguist, a circle of ink, and time that is not a line. The weapon is a gift if you can stand to know.
tagline: There Are Days That Define Your Story Beyond Your Life

title: The Witch
overview: New England woods, a goat named Black Phillip, and a family that brought their own fear with them. Wouldst thou like to live deliciously?

title: A Christmas Story
overview: A Red Ryder carbine-action two-hundred-shot range model air rifle, a tongue on a flagpole, and a department-store Santa who wants you off his lap.

title: The Notebook
overview: A notebook read aloud in a home, a summer in the South, and rain that solves an argument. The letters were always there.
tagline: If You're A Bird, I'm A Bird

title: 10 Things I Hate About You
overview: Shakespeare in a Seattle high school. Kat does not want to date. Bianca is not allowed to until she does. Heath Ledger on the bleachers.
tagline: I Hate The Way I Don't Hate You

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
overview: A hobbit inherits a ring and a walk. The fellowship is named, the mines are entered, and the river takes them south.
tagline: Even The Smallest Person Can Change The Course Of The Future

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
overview: A cupboard, a letter, a train on a platform that is not there. Hogwarts as the first tape a lot of kids ever rewound twice.

title: Shrek
overview: An ogre, a donkey, a princess with a secret, and a fairy-tale swamp that did not ask for company. The layer is the onion.

title: Finding Nemo
overview: A clownfish crosses an ocean because his kid got collected. Dory remembers, eventually. The dentist tank is a prison movie.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
overview: A blacksmith, a governor's daughter, a compass that does not point north, and a curse that moonlight makes obvious.
tagline: This Is The Day You Will Always Remember As The Day You Almost Caught Captain Jack Sparrow

title: Batman
overview: Keaton in the cowl, Nicholson in the grin, and a Gotham that looks like a German Expressionist department store. Dance with the devil in the pale moonlight.

title: The Lost Boys
overview: Santa Carla, a boardwalk, a comic-shop vampire kit, and Kiefer Sutherland on a beach. Sleep all day. Party all night.
tagline: One Thing About Living In Santa Carla I Never Could Stomach: All The Damn Vampires

title: Heathers
overview: Westerburg High, a cafeteria hierarchy, and a transfer student with a croquet idea. Dear diary, my teen angst has a body count.

title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
overview: Indy and his dad on a grail hunt. Sean Connery, a tank, a leap of faith, and a chosen cup that is not the shiny one.

title: Beauty and the Beast
overview: A castle of household objects, a girl who reads, a beast who learns. The ballroom still stops the aisle.

title: The Little Mermaid
overview: A mermaid trades her voice for legs. The sea witch keeps the receipt. Under the sea is the number they came for.

title: Sleepless in Seattle
overview: A kid calls the radio. A woman in Baltimore hears it. The Empire State Building has a date with fate and a violin.
tagline: Those Were The Days When People Knew How To Be In Love

title: Ghost
overview: A banker is murdered, stays, and learns pottery. Whoopi Goldberg as a medium who did not ask for this shift.

title: Amadeus
overview: Salieri vs. a vulgar miracle. The laugh, the manuscripts, the confession. Mediocrity has a name and a wig.
tagline: Forgive Me, Majesty. I Am A Vulgar Man.

title: Annie Hall
overview: A comedian, a singer, lobsters, a Brooklyn pier, and subtitles for what they actually think. It was a great weekend in the country.

title: Rain Man
overview: A hustler inherits a brother instead of money. Cross-country, counting cards, and Qantas never crashed.

title: The Hurt Locker
overview: A bomb tech who is only calm in the suit. Baghdad heat, a countdown, and a cereal aisle that feels like the dangerous part.
tagline: You'll Know One When You See One

title: Slumdog Millionaire
overview: A kid on a game show who knows the answers because he lived them. Mumbai as a flashback engine. The dance is the credits.

title: The Shape of Water
overview: A mute janitor, a river god in a tank, Cold War labs, and a love story that is also a creature feature. Eggs, records, rain.
tagline: A Fairy Tale For Troubled Times

title: Nomadland
overview: A woman sells the house and lives in the van. Amazon season, desert friends, and a horizon that is the point.

title: Poor Things
overview: A woman reanimated with a child's brain goes to Lisbon, Paris, and then some. Bella Baxter invents herself in public.
tagline: I Am A Woman Inventing Herself

title: The Zone of Interest
overview: A family house next to a camp. The horror is over the wall and on the soundtrack. Flowers, a river, a party.

title: Past Lives
overview: Two kids in Seoul, twenty years, a bar in New York, and a walk to an Uber. What if is the whole plot.
tagline: You Dream In A Language I Can't Understand

title: Aftersun
overview: A holiday camcorder, a father, a daughter, a rave that is also a memory. The last dance is the one that wrecks you.
tagline: I Think It's Nice That We Share The Same Sky

title: Perfect Days
overview: A Tokyo toilet cleaner, cassette tapes, trees, and a routine that is a life. Komorebi is the word. The smile at the end is the review.
tagline: Next Time Is Next Time. Now Is Now.

title: Drive My Car
overview: A widower, a Chekhov production, a driver, a red Saab, and conversations that take the long way home.

title: Decision to Leave
overview: A detective, a widow, mountains and sea, and a case that is also a romance. The translator app is doing overtime.
tagline: I Didn't Kill Him. The Mountain Did.

title: Nope
overview: A ranch that supplies horses to Hollywood, a cloud that is not a cloud, and a rule about looking. I got a bad feeling.

title: The Menu
overview: A tasting menu on an island you cannot leave. The chef has notes. The s'more is not a joke. Don't eat the bread.
tagline: You Will Eat What We Serve You

title: Godzilla Minus One
overview: Postwar Japan vs. the thing that will not stay sunk. A kamikaze who lived, a wooden plane, and a city that already lost once.

title: Talk to Me
overview: An embalmed hand, a party game, ninety seconds in the other place. Grief as a high that will not come down.

title: Longlegs
overview: A FBI agent, a coded letters case, and a basement that has been waiting. The birthday balloons are not for you.
tagline: Mommy, Daddy, I Would Like A Serial Killer For My Birthday

title: I Saw the TV Glow
overview: A late-night show about a buried pink, a high school that feels like a waiting room, and a decade that is also a grave.

title: Anora
overview: A Brighton Beach dancer marries a Russian heir. The family objects. The week that follows is a screwball tragedy in a fur coat.
tagline: You Don't Know Who My Husband Is

title: The Substance
overview: An aerobics star takes a serum that makes a younger self. One week each. The bathroom tile remembers everything.
tagline: You Are The Matrix. Everything Comes From You.

title: Nosferatu
overview: A plague ship, a count who is hunger in a coat, and a woman who agrees to the door. Eggers goes back to the shadow.

title: Challengers
overview: A love triangle played as a tennis match. The scoreboard is the plot. Zendaya with a visor and a scheme.

title: Wicked
overview: Elphaba and Glinda at Shiz, before the broom. Defying gravity still hits in a packed house. Part one of a green origin.

title: Sinners
overview: Twins, a juke joint, Mississippi 1932, and something that wants in. Coogler puts vampires in the blues and lets the music work.
tagline: The Night Is Young. The Hungry Are Older.

title: Superman
overview: A kind superhero in a loud world. The dog flies. The interview matters. Gunn's cape is brighter than the last decade of grim.

title: Wicked: For Good
overview: The second half of the green story. For good is a promise and a threat. The aisle still has sparkles in the carpet.

title: Zootopia 2
overview: Judy and Nick back on a case in a city that still pretends it solved prejudice. The reptiles have arrived. So has the sequel.

title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
overview: Pandora again, fire people, ash sky. Cameron still wants you in a chair that tilts. The clan is not done fighting.

title: Mickey 17
overview: An expendable on an ice planet who keeps dying and coming back. Bong in English, with a clone who would like a word.

title: Mission: Impossible – The Final Reckoning
overview: Ethan Hunt vs. the Entity, a submarine, and a plane that should not be hanging onto another plane. One more impossible.
tagline: We Live And Die In The Shadows

title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
overview: A retro-future family of four vs. a planet-eater. Silver Surfer on the horizon. The 60s never looked this expensive.

title: Jurassic World Rebirth
overview: The park idea again, with DNA that should have stayed buried. Edwards knows how to show a creature and then not show it.

title: How to Train Your Dragon
overview: Live-action Berk, a viking who would rather sketch than fight, a night fury in the cove. The animated one still plays. This one flies anyway.
tagline: Everything We Know About You Guys Is Wrong

title: The Naked Gun
overview: Frank Drebin Jr. inherits the badge and the deadpan. Leslie Nielsen is gone. The puns refused to retire.

title: Predator: Badlands
overview: A young Predator on a hunt that is also a coming-of-age. No Arnold. Still the clicks. The skulls are the résumé.
tagline: If It Bleeds, We Can Still Kill It

title: A Minecraft Movie
overview: Jack Black in a cube world, because of course. The overworld, the nether, a chicken that should not be that fast.

title: 28 Years Later
overview: The infection never left the island. A kid, a journey, a mainland that moved on. Boyle and Garland rewind the rage.
tagline: The Island Is Not Safe. Neither Is The Mainland.

title: Weapons
overview: Seventeen kids leave their houses at 2:17 a.m. and vanish. A small town that cannot explain the same night twice.

title: F1
overview: Brad Pitt in a cockpit, real tracks, real speed. Kosinski does for Formula One what he did for jets: make the camera a passenger.

title: The Odyssey
overview: Homer at IMAX scale. A soldier trying to get home, gods that do not make it easy, and a sea that is also a maze.

title: A Clockwork Orange
overview: In a near-future Britain, young Alexander DeLarge and his pals get their kicks beating and raping anyone they please. When not destroying the lives of others, Alex swoons to the music of Beethoven. The state, eager to crack down on juvenile crime, gives an incarcerated Alex the option to undergo an invasive procedure that'll rob him of all personal agency. In a time when conscience is a commodity, can Alex change his tune?
tagline: Being the adventures of a young man whose principal interests are rape, ultra-violence and Beethoven.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
overview: Peter Parker after the spell. A new day that is not as clean as the title. The mask is back on. The city did not forget.

title: After Hours
overview: Desperate to escape his mind-numbing routine, uptown Manhattan office worker Paul Hackett ventures downtown for a hookup with a mystery woman.
tagline: When it's after midnight in New York City, you don't have to look for love, laughter and trouble. They'll all find you!

title: Toy Story 5
overview: The toys are back on the shelf, and the kid has a phone now. Andy's room keeps changing. The cowboy does not.

title: Project Hail Mary
overview: A teacher wakes up on a spaceship with a mission he does not remember and a spider-rock alien who might be the friend.

title: Akira
overview: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath that only two teenagers and a group of psychics can stop.

title: Moana
overview: Live-action ocean, same song about how far she'll go. The water still knows her. The demigod still needs a push.

title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
overview: Mario leaves the Mushroom Kingdom for the stars. Lumas, a comet observatory, and a plumber who still jumps on turtles.

title: Dune: Part Three
overview: Paul's holy war comes due. Messiah is not a compliment. The desert is still listening. Street date December 18.

title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
overview: Haymitch's Games, years before Katniss. The Capitol already knew how to make a show. Street date November 20.
tagline: It's A Birthday Gift. They Call It The Reaping.

title: The Social Reckoning
overview: Sorkin goes back to the deposition room. The company got bigger. The damage did too. Street date October 9.
tagline: The Sequel To The Social Network

title: Basket Case
overview: A young man carrying a big basket that contains his extremely deformed, formerly conjoined twin brother seeks vengeance on the doctors who separated them against their will.
tagline: The tenant in room 7 is very small, very twisted, and very mad.

title: Clayface
overview: A Batman villain who is also a tragedy about a face that will not stay. Horror-lane DC. Street date October 23.
tagline: A Face That Will Not Hold

title: Beetlejuice
overview: A newly dead New England couple seeks help from a deranged demon exorcist to scare an affluent New York family out of their home.
tagline: In this house... if you've seen one ghost... you haven't seen them all.

title: Violent Night 2
overview: Santa with a hammer, round two. Christmas Eve at the store just got another reason to stay open late. Street date December 4.

title: Big Fish
overview: Throughout his life Edward Bloom has always been a man of big appetites, enormous passions and tall tales. In his later years, he remains a huge mystery to his son, William. Now, to get to know the real man, Will begins piecing together a true picture of his father from flashbacks of his amazing adventures.
tagline: An adventure as big as life itself.

title: Focker-in-Law
overview: The Fockers again, because the in-laws never actually leave. Street date November 25, right when the gravy starts arguments.

title: Remain
overview: Shyamalan with a title that is also an instruction. February 5 street date. The twist is probably in the first scene this time.

title: Carrie
overview: Withdrawn and sensitive teenager Carrie White faces bullying from her classmates and abuse from her fanatically pious mother. When she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers, things take a dark and violent turn.
tagline: If you've got a taste for terror...Take Carrie to the prom!

title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
overview: Gerwig at the beginning of Narnia: rings, attics, a wood between worlds. Street date February 12.

title: Star Wars: Starfighter
overview: A new Star Wars with a cockpit in the title. Ryan Gosling, a galaxy that is not done. Street date May 28.

title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
overview: Miles's story was not finished. The society, the leap, the last chapter they promised. Street date June 18.

title: Shrek 5
overview: The ogre returns because the swamp is never actually left alone. Street date June 30. Somebody will want an onion joke.
tagline: Get Out Of My Swamp. Again.

title: Man of Tomorrow
overview: Superman's next flight. Street date July 9. The cape stays hopeful. The world does not.

title: Avengers: Secret Wars
overview: Every leftover universe on one battlefield. Street date December 17. The board will have a line. The clerk will need a stool.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum
overview: Serkis directing the creature he performed. A hunt through the gaps of the trilogy. Street date December 17.

title: Gremlins 3
overview: Do not get them wet. Do not feed them after midnight. The rules are the same. Street date November 19, right on the holiday wall.

title: Frozen 3
overview: Arendelle again. The snow does not melt between sequels. Street date late November, when the tinsel is already up.
tagline: The Cold Still Never Bothered Her

title: Dawn of the Dead
overview: During an ever-growing epidemic of zombies that have risen from the dead, two Philadelphia SWAT team members, a traffic reporter, and his television-executive girlfriend seek refuge in a secluded shopping mall.
tagline: When there’s no more room in HELL, the dead will walk the EARTH!

title: Godzilla x Kong: Supernova
overview: The titans clock in for another round. Street date March 26. The clerk files it under action and does not take questions.

title: Dazed and Confused
overview: The adventures of a group of Texas teens on their last day of school in 1976, centering on student Randall Floyd, who moves easily among stoners, jocks and geeks. Floyd is a star athlete, but he also likes smoking weed, which presents a conundrum when his football coach demands he sign a "no drugs" pledge.
tagline: It was the last day of school in 1976. A time they'd never forget. (If only they could remember)

title: The Legend of Zelda
overview: Hyrule on a street date of April 30. A sword, a princess, a timeline argument the clerks will have all summer.

title: Inside Out 2
overview: Riley hits puberty and Anxiety moves into headquarters. The core memories have to make room. Pixar in the feelings again.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
overview: The merc with a mouth drags a tired Wolverine through the TVA. It's a comic-book movie that knows it's a rental.

title: Doctor Sleep
overview: Still scarred by the trauma he endured as a child at the Overlook Hotel, Dan Torrance faces the ghosts of the past when he meets Abra, a courageous teen who desperately needs his help -- and who possesses a powerful extrasensory ability called the "shine".

title: Moana 2
overview: The ocean calls her back. A new crew, a longer way to go, same navigator's heart.

title: Twisters
overview: Storm chasers, a bigger sky, and a sequel that actually wants you to feel the wind. Oklahoma as a character.
tagline: If You Feel It, Chase It

title: Donnie Darko
overview: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a large bunny rabbit that manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.
tagline: 28 days, 6 hours, 42 minutes, 12 seconds... that is when the world will end.

title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
overview: The ghost with the most clocks back in. Winona, Jenna, and a handbook you still shouldn't read out loud.

title: Alien: Romulus
overview: Young scavengers, a derelict station, and the same dripping nightmare. In space, the rental still screams.
tagline: In Space, No One Can Hear You. Still.

title: Ed Wood
overview: The mostly true story of the legendary "worst director of all time", who, with the help of his strange friends, filmed countless B-movies without ever becoming famous or successful.
tagline: Movies were his passion. Women were his inspiration. Angora sweaters were his weakness.

title: The Wild Robot
overview: A shipwrecked robot raises a gosling on an island that did not ask for technology. Kindness with a titanium shell.

title: Civil War
overview: Journalists driving toward a Washington that is already a battlefield. Garland keeps the politics in the rifle scope.
tagline: What Kind Of American Are You?

title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
overview: How the missing arm happened. How the war rig was earned. The wasteland, younger and meaner.

title: Edward Scissorhands
overview: A small suburban town receives a visit from a castaway unfinished science experiment named Edward.
tagline: Innocence is what he knows. Beauty is what she sees.

title: Conclave
overview: A pope dies. The cardinals lock the doors. The thriller is in the whispering and the smoke.

title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
overview: An alien is left behind on Earth and saved by the 10-year-old Elliott who decides to keep him hidden in his home. While a task force hunts for the extra-terrestrial, Elliott, his brother, and his little sister Gertie form an emotional bond with their new friend, and try to help him find his way home.
tagline: He is afraid. He is totally alone. He is 3,000,000 light years from home.

title: Evil Dead 2
overview: Ash Williams and his girlfriend Linda find a log cabin in the woods with a voice recording from an archeologist who had recorded himself reciting ancient chants from the Book of the Dead. As they play the recording an evil power is unleashed taking over Linda's body.

title: Four Rooms
overview: It's Ted the Bellhop's first night on the job...and the hotel's very unusual guests are about to place him in some outrageous predicaments. It seems that this evening's room service is serving up one unbelievable happening after another.
tagline: Twelve outrageous guests. Four scandalous requests. And one lone bellhop, in his first day on the job, who's in for the wildest New year's Eve of his life.

title: Grease
overview: Australian good girl Sandy and greaser Danny fell in love over the summer. But when they unexpectedly discover they're now in the same high school, will they be able to rekindle their romance despite their eccentric friends?

title: Hard Boiled
overview: A cop who loses his partner in a shoot-out with gun smugglers goes on a mission to catch them. In order to get closer to the leaders of the ring he joins forces with an undercover cop who's working as a gangster hitman. They use all means of excessive force to find them.
tagline: As a cop, he has brains, brawn, and an instinct to kill.

title: Home Alone
overview: Eight-year-old Kevin McCallister makes the most of the situation after his family unwittingly leaves him behind when they go on vacation. But when a pair of bungling burglars set their sights on Kevin's house, the plucky kid stands ready to defend his territory.
tagline: A family comedy without the family.

title: Labyrinth
overview: Frustrated with babysitting on yet another weekend night, Sarah, a teenager with an active imagination, summons the Goblins to take her baby stepbrother away. When little Toby actually disappears, Sarah must follow him into a fantastical world to rescue him from the Goblin King. Guarding his castle is the labyrinth itself, a twisted maze of deception, populated with outrageous characters and unknown dangers.
tagline: Where everything seems possible and nothing is what it seems.

title: Mad Max 2
overview: Max Rockatansky returns as the heroic loner who drives the dusty roads of a postapocalyptic Australian Outback in an unending search for gasoline. Arrayed against him and the other scraggly defendants of a fuel-depot encampment are the bizarre warriors commanded by the charismatic Lord Humungus, a violent leader whose scruples are as barren as the surrounding landscape.
tagline: Just one man can make a difference.

title: Manhunter
overview: FBI Agent Will Graham, retired after catching notorious cannibal Hannibal Lecter, returns to duty to engage in a risky cat-and-mouse game with Lecter to capture a new killer.
tagline: It's just you and me now, sport…

title: Near Dark
overview: A farm boy reluctantly becomes a member of the undead when a girl he meets turns out to be part of a band of vampires who roam the highways in stolen cars.

title: Night of the Comet
overview: After a comet wipes out most of life on Earth, two Valley Girls find themselves fighting against cannibal zombies and a sinister group of scientists.
tagline: They came. They Shopped. They saved the world!

title: Nightmare on Elm Street
overview: Teenagers in a small town are dropping like flies, apparently in the grip of mass hysteria causing their suicides. A cop's daughter, Nancy Thompson, traces the cause to child molester Fred Krueger, who was burned alive by angry parents many years before.
tagline: If Nancy doesn't wake up screaming, she won't wake up at all.

title: Oldboy
overview: With no clue how he came to be imprisoned, drugged and tortured for 15 years, a desperate man seeks revenge on his captors.
tagline: 15 years of imprisonment, five days of vengeance.

title: Poltergeist
overview: The Freelings' suburban home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a portal to the 'other side'. With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

title: Pretty Woman
overview: Vivian is a carefree, streetwise diamond in the rough when she meets sophisticated billionaire Edward in a chance encounter that turns into a week-long business arrangement. But Vivian's energetic spirit challenges Edward's no-nonsense approach to life, and soon they are teaching each other – and falling in love!
tagline: She walked off the street, into his life and stole his heart.

title: Princess Mononoke
overview: Ashitaka, a prince of the disappearing Emishi people, is cursed by a demonized boar god and must journey to the west to find a cure. Along the way, he encounters San, a young human woman fighting to protect the forest, and Lady Eboshi, who is trying to destroy it. Ashitaka must find a way to bring balance to this conflict.
tagline: The fate of the world rests on the courage of one warrior.

title: Psycho
overview: When larcenous real estate clerk Marion Crane goes on the lam with a wad of cash and hopes of starting a new life, she ends up at the notorious Bates Motel, where manager Norman Bates cares for his housebound mother.
tagline: A new and altogether different screen excitement!

title: Rear Window
overview: A wheelchair-bound photographer spies on his neighbors from his apartment window and becomes convinced one of them has committed murder.
tagline: It only takes one witness to spoil the perfect crime.

title: Repo Man
overview: A down and out young punk gets a job working with a seasoned repo man, but what awaits him in his new career is a series of outlandish adventures revolving around aliens, the CIA, and a most wanted '64 Chevy.
tagline: It’s 4 a.m. Do you know where your car is?

title: Rocky
overview: Rocky Balboa is a Philadelphia club fighter who seems to be going nowhere. But when a stroke of fate puts him in the ring with a world heavyweight champion, Rocky knows that it's his one shot at the big time — a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to go the distance and come out a winner!
tagline: His whole life was a million-to-one shot.

title: Rosemarys Baby
overview: A young couple, Rosemary and Guy, moves into an infamous New York apartment building, known by frightening legends and mysterious events, with the purpose of starting a family.

title: Scarface
overview: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fueled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.
tagline: He loved the American Dream. With a vengeance.

title: Scream
overview: A year after the murder of her mother, a teenage girl is terrorized by a masked killer who targets her and her friends by using scary movies as part of a deadly game.
tagline: Someone has taken their love of scary movies one step too far. Solving this mystery is going to be murder.

title: Society
overview: Bill Whitney is worried that he is different to his sister and parents. They mix with other upper-class people while Bill is more down to earth. Even his girlfriend seems a bit odd. All is revealed when Bill returns home to find a party in full swing.
tagline: The rich have always fed off the poor. This time, it's for real.

title: Speed
overview: Tensions run high when a crazed bomber rigs a Los Angeles bus with a device that will kill everyone on board if the vehicle's speed dips below fifty miles per hour.

title: Suspiria
overview: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.
tagline: Do You Know Anything About Witches?

title: The Big Lebowski
overview: Jeffrey 'The Dude' Lebowski, a Los Angeles slacker who only wants to bowl and drink White Russians, is mistaken for another Jeffrey Lebowski, a wheelchair-bound millionaire, and finds himself dragged into a strange series of events involving nihilists, adult film producers, ferrets, errant toes, and large sums of money.
tagline: Times like these call for a Big Lebowski.

title: The Crow
overview: Exactly one year after young rock guitarist Eric Draven and his fiancée are brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals, Draven, watched over by a hypnotic crow, returns from the grave to exact revenge.

title: The Devils Advocate
overview: Aspiring Florida defense lawyer Kevin Lomax accepts a job at a New York law firm. With the stakes getting higher every case, Kevin quickly learns that his boss has something far more evil planned.
tagline: The newest attorney at the world's most powerful law firm has never lost a case. But he's about to lose his soul.

title: The Door in the Floor
overview: A writer's young assistant becomes both pawn and catalyst in his boss's disintegrating household.
tagline: The most dangerous secrets are the ones we're afraid to tell ourselves.

title: The Exorcist
overview: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.
tagline: Something almost beyond comprehension is happening to a girl on this street, in this house…And a man has been sent for as a last resort. This man is The Exorcist.

title: The Fly
overview: When brilliant, eccentric scientist Seth Brundle makes a huge technological breakthrough in teleportation, he decides to test it on himself. Unbeknownst to him, a common housefly manages to get inside the device and the two become one.

title: The Goonies
overview: Young teen Mikey Walsh and his friends set off on a quest to find Pirate One-Eyed Willie's treasure in hopes of saving their homes from demolition. However, on their quest to find the treasure, they run into a family of recently escaped criminals, determined to capture the kids and reach the treasure first.
tagline: They call themselves "The Goonies." The secret caves. The old lighthouse. The lost map. The treacherous traps. The hidden adventure. And Sloth… Join the adventure.

title: The Hurricane
overview: The story of Rubin "Hurricane" Carter, a boxer wrongly imprisoned for murder, and the people who aided in his fight to prove his innocence.
tagline: His greatest fight was for justice.

title: The Karate Kid
overview: New Jersey teen Daniel LaRusso moves to Los Angeles with his mother, and soon strikes up a relationship with Ali. He quickly finds himself the target of bullying by a group of thugs, led by Ali's ex-boyfriend Johnny, who study karate at the Cobra Kai dojo under ruthless sensei John Kreese. Fortunately, Daniel befriends Mr. Miyagi, an unassuming repairman who just happens to be a martial arts master himself. Miyagi takes Daniel under his wing, training him in a more compassionate form of karate for self-defense and, later, preparing him to compete against the brutal Cobra Kai.
tagline: He taught him the secret to karate lies in the mind and heart. Not in the hands.

title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
overview: After getting a flat tire in the middle of nowhere, newly engaged couple Brad and Janet encounter the eerie mansion of the flamboyant, seductive Dr Frank-N-Furter and a variety of eccentric characters. Through elaborate dance and rock music, the mad scientist unveils his latest creation: a perfect, muscular man.

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
overview: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way, they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.
tagline: Who will survive and what will be left of them?

title: The Warriors
overview: Prominent gang leader Cyrus calls a meeting of New York's gangs to set aside their turf wars and take over the city. At the meeting, a rival leader kills Cyrus, but a Coney Island gang called the Warriors is wrongly blamed for Cyrus' death. Before you know it, the cops and every gangbanger in town is hot on the Warriors' trail.
tagline: These are the armies of the night. They are 100,000 strong. They outnumber the cops five to one. They could run New York City. Tonight they're all out to get the Warriors.

title: Total Recall
overview: Construction worker Douglas Quaid's obsession with the planet Mars leads him to visit Rekall, a virtual vacation company that manufactures memories. When something goes wrong during Quaid's memory implant procedure, his life turns upside down, leading him to question what is reality and what isn't.
tagline: Get ready for the ride of your life.

title: Tremors
overview: Val McKee and Earl Bassett are in a fight for their lives when they discover that their desolate town has been infested with gigantic, man-eating creatures that live below the ground.
tagline: They say there's nothing new under the sun. But under the ground…

title: Vertigo
overview: A retired San Francisco detective suffering from acrophobia investigates the strange activities of an old friend's wife, all the while becoming dangerously obsessed with her.
tagline: Alfred Hitchcock engulfs you in a whirlpool of terror and tension!

title: Jaws
overview: A shark closes the beach. The sheriff, a scientist, and a scarred captain go out on a boat that is too small. The score does the rest.

title: Halloween
overview: Haddonfield, October 31st. A shape in a mask walks the suburbs like he never left. Laurie is babysitting. The score is two notes.

title: Alien
tagline: In space no one can hear you scream.
overview: The Nostromo answers a signal. Kane's chest does not. Then the vents, the cat, and a company that wanted the specimen more than the crew.

title: The Shining
overview: A winter caretaker, a maze, and a hotel that has always been here. The boy talks to his finger. The father talks to the bar.

title: First Blood
tagline: This time he's fighting for his life.
overview: A drifter with a Medal of Honor walks into a small-town sheriff and a forest that becomes a war. They should have let him pass.

title: Blade Runner
tagline: Man has made his match... now it's time to play.
overview: Rain, neon, and a cop who hunts replicants that want more life. The question is whether he is one of them.

title: The Thing
overview: An Antarctic station. A dog that isn't a dog. Blood tests and flamethrowers until nobody trusts a face.

title: Back to the Future
tagline: He was never in time for his classes... Now he isn't in time for his dad.
overview: A DeLorean, 1.21 gigawatts, and a kid who has to make his parents fall in love so he can get back to 1985.

title: Die Hard
tagline: Twelve terrorists. One cop. The odds are against John McClane.
overview: Nakatomi Plaza on Christmas Eve. A New York cop in bare feet, a German with a suit, and the LAPD parked outside.

title: Goodfellas
tagline: Three decades of life in the Mafia.
overview: Henry Hill wanted to be a somebody. Then the night at the Copa, the Lufthansa job, and a helicopter that will not leave him alone.

title: The Lion King
overview: A cub runs from the Pridelands and grows up between a meerkat and a warthog. Then the ghost of his father tells him to go home.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: A banker is sentenced to Shawshank and spends two decades with a rock hammer, a library, and a poster. Red tells it like a man who learned to wait.

title: Pulp Fiction
tagline: You won't know the facts until you've seen the fiction.
overview: A briefcase, a dance contest, and a miracle in an apartment. The chapters shuffle. The dialogue does not.

title: Heat
overview: A thief who will not get attached and a detective who already has. Downtown L.A. rifles, a diner, and two men who recognize each other.

tagline: To live would be an awfully big adventure.

tagline: Somewhere inside all of us is the power to change the world.

overview: Mr. Wilson's ever-present annoyance comes in the form of one mischievous kid named Dennis. But he'll need Dennis's tricks to uncover a collection of gold coins that go missing when a shady drifter named Switchblade Sam comes to town.

overview: A young boy is scared of the monster under his bed. He asks his 6th grade brother to swap rooms for the night as a bet that the monster really exists.
tagline: They cause all the trouble. But you’ll have all the fun.

overview: The scientist father of a teenage girl and boy accidentally shrinks his and two other neighborhood teens to the size of insects. Now the teens must fight diminutive dangers as the father searches for them.

overview: While hiding from bullies in his school's attic, a young boy discovers the extraordinary land of Fantasia, through a magical book called The Neverending Story.

title: Flight of the Navigator
overview: 12-year-old David is accidentally knocked out in the forest near his home, but when he awakens eight years have passed. His family is overjoyed to have him back, but is just as perplexed as he is that he hasn't aged.

title: *batteries not included
overview: In a soon to be demolished block of apartments, the residents resist the criminal methods used to force them to leave so a greedy tycoon can build his new skyscraper. When tiny mechanical aliens land for a recharge, they decide to stay and help out.

title: Explorers
overview: Middle schooler Ben spends his free time watching sci-fi films, playing video games and reading comic books.
tagline: The adventure begins in your own back yard.

title: Return to Oz
overview: Dorothy, saved from a psychiatric experiment by a mysterious girl, finds herself back in the land of her dreams, and makes delightful new friends, and dangerous new enemies.
tagline: An all-new adventure down the yellow brick road.

title: Ladyhawke
overview: Captain Etienne Navarre is a man on whose shoulders lies a cruel curse. Punished for loving each other, Navarre must become a wolf by night whilst his lover, Lady Isabeau, takes the form of a hawk by day.

title: The Secret Garden
overview: A young British girl born and reared in India loses her neglectful parents in an earthquake. She is returned to England to live at her uncle's castle. Her uncle is very distant due to the loss of his wife ten years before.

title: A Little Princess
overview: When her father enlists to fight for the British in WWI, young Sara Crewe goes to New York to attend the same boarding school her late mother attended.
tagline: No miracle is ever too small.

title: Casper
overview: Casper is a kind young ghost who peacefully haunts a mansion in Maine. When specialist James Harvey arrives to communicate with Casper and his fellow spirits, he brings along his teenage daughter, Kat.

title: The Witches
overview: While staying at a hotel in England with his grandmother, Helga, a young boy named Luke inadvertently spies on a convention of witches. The Grand High Witch reveals a plan to turn all children into mice via a magical formula.

title: Drop Dead Fred
overview: An unhappy housewife gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred.
tagline: Dishes. Relationships. Wind. This Guy Breaks Everything.

overview: Amiable slackers Bill and Ted are once again roped into a fantastical adventure when De Nomolos, a villain from the future, sends evil robot duplicates of the two lads to terminate and replace them.
tagline: Once... they made history. Now... they are history.

title: The 'Burbs
overview: When secretive new neighbors move in next door, suburbanite Ray Peterson and his friends let their paranoia get the best of them as they start to suspect the newcomers of evildoings and commence an investigation.
tagline: He's a man of peace in a savage land... Suburbia.

title: Pump Up the Volume
overview: Mark Hunter, a lonely high school student, uses his shortwave radio to moonlight as the popular pirate DJ "Hard Harry." When his show gets blamed for a teen committing suicide, the students clash with high school faculty and the authorities.

title: Can't Buy Me Love
overview: Nerdy high schooler Ronald Miller rescues cheerleader Cindy Mancini from parental punishment after she accidentally destroys her mother's designer clothes.

title: Some Kind of Wonderful
overview: Keith Nelson, an artsy high school outcast, tries to land a date with popular girl Amanda Jones with some help from his tomboy best friend, Watts.
tagline: Before they could stand together, they had to stand alone.

title: Bull Durham
overview: Veteran catcher Crash Davis is brought to the minor league Durham Bulls to help their up and coming pitching prospect, "Nuke" Laloosh.

title: Major League
overview: When Rachel Phelps inherits the Cleveland Indians from her deceased husband, she's determined to move the team to a warmer climate—but only a losing season will make that possible, which should be easy given the misfits she's hired.
tagline: A comedy with bats and balls.

title: Rudy
overview: Rudy grew up in a steel mill town where most people ended up working, but wanted to play football at Notre Dame instead. There were only a couple of problems.

title: Remember the Titans
overview: After leading his football team to 15 winning seasons, coach Bill Yoast is demoted and replaced by Herman Boone – tough, opinionated and as different from the beloved Yoast as he could be.
tagline: History is written by the winners.

title: Friday Night Lights
overview: A small, turbulent town in Texas obsesses over their high school football team to an unhealthy degree.
tagline: Hope comes alive on Friday nights.

title: Miracle
overview: When college coach Herb Brooks is hired to helm the 1980 U.S. men's Olympic hockey team, he brings a unique and brash style to the ice.
tagline: The story of the greatest moment in sports history.

title: The Mighty Ducks
overview: After reckless young lawyer Gordon Bombay gets arrested for drunk driving, he must coach a kids hockey team for his community service.
tagline: They can't skate. They can't win. They can't be serious.

title: Space Jam
overview: With their freedom on the line, the Looney Tunes seek the help of NBA superstar Michael Jordan to win a basketball game against a team of moronic aliens.
genres: Family, Science Fiction, Fantasy, Comedy, Animation

title: White Men Can't Jump
overview: Two street basketball hustlers try to con each other, then team up for a bigger score.
tagline: It ain't easy being this good.

title: Hoosiers
overview: Failed college coach Norman Dale gets a chance at redemption when he is hired to coach a high school basketball team in a tiny Indiana town.
tagline: They needed a second chance to finish first.

title: Breaking Away
overview: Dave, nineteen, has just graduated high school, with his three friends: the comical Cyril, the warm hearted but short-tempered Moocher, and the athletic, spiteful but good-hearted Mike.

title: Chariots of Fire
overview: In the class-obsessed and religiously divided UK of the early 1920s, two determined young runners train for the 1924 Paris Olympics.

overview: Following Rocky Balboa's intense battle with his most powerful adversary yet – the ferocious Clubber Lang – Rocky joins forces with former rival Apollo Creed in an effort to get back his fighting spirit.

overview: Between personal obligations and training for his next big fight against an opponent with ties to his family's past, Adonis Creed is up against the challenge of his life.
tagline: There's more to lose than a title.

title: Cool Runnings

tagline: One dream. Four Jamaicans. Twenty below zero.

title: Warrior

title: Jerry Maguire

tagline: Putting the funk into the dunk.
